references.text: The Lord tells Gideon that He has given the Midianite camp into his hand, the same message Gideon relays to the Israelites in verse 15
The dream and its interpretation that Gideon heard from the Midianites, which gave him courage to worship and return to the Israelite camp
Moses encourages the people with similar words that the Lord will fight for them and that they will see the Lord's salvation
The Lord promises to give the enemy into Israel's hand, the same promise Gideon relays
David expresses similar faith that the Lord grants victory, not by sword or spear, but by the power of the Lord
Similar encouragement that the battle is the Lord's and that He will give the enemy into their hands
Deborah gives Barak the same kind of encouragement: 'Arise, for this is the day when the Lord has given Sisera into your hand'
